The main agenda item was the preparation for the annual audit. The Chairman noted that the
audit is scheduled to begin in March, and it is important that all records are made available to
the auditors in a timely manner. The Board discussed the need to ensure that all financial
transactions for the 2025 fiscal year are properly documented and reconciled.

After considerable discussion, the Board adopted the following resolutions:

**Resolution 2026/02/01:** That the Federation engages the services of an external auditor for
the 2025 fiscal year audit, to be conducted in March 2026.

**Resolution 2026/02/02:** That the Secretary General is directed to liaise with the external
auditor to schedule the audit and arrange for the provision of all necessary documents and
records.

**Resolution 2026/02/03:** That the Treasurer is directed to prepare a detailed statement of
all income and expenditure for the 2025 fiscal year, to be submitted to the external auditor
before the commencement of the audit.

The Chairman also raised the matter of the upcoming cooperative congress, scheduled for April
2026. The Board discussed the venue, the budget, and the need to invite a representative from
the Federal Ministry of Agriculture. A committee was formed to handle the logistics, comprising
Mrs. Grace Okafor (Chair), Mr. Chinedu Okafor, and Dr. Femi Adewale.

There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 11:45 AM.

The next meeting is scheduled for March 12, 2026.

Please review the attached minutes and resolutions. Kindly send any corrections or comments to
me by Tuesday, February 17, 2026.
